title: Alpha derivation from CSS theme tokens using color-mix
answers: How to create semi-transparent color variants of theme tokens in mitmweb?
Can LESS color functions like lighten or fadeout be used with CSS variables in mitmweb?
What is the convention for transparent overlays and masks on theme tokens?
body:
In mitmweb stylesheets (web/src/css/), do not use LESS color manipulation functions (lighten, darken, fadeout) because they cannot operate on CSS var() tokens.
All theme color tokens must be defined under :root and mirrored under [data-theme="dark"] in web/src/css/global.less as --mitmweb-* custom properties.
When an element requires alpha transparency or tinting over a token, use native CSS color-mix(in srgb, var(...) <percentage>, transparent) as seen in web/src/css/flowtable.less:&.sort-asc:after, &.sort-desc:after.
applies: LESS stylesheets in web/src/css/ referencing --mitmweb-* tokens
says: Table column sort indicators look completely opaque instead of translucent against the header.
Selection overlays and hover tints do not blend cleanly with custom theme colors.
Make transparent table highlight colors adapt properly to both light and dark themes.
Translucent badges and row hover backgrounds look solid instead of semi transparent.
